html:
core/safari/patches/carousel-media.ts

Carousel-hosted media overrides for iOS/Safari — WebKit
Source src/core/safari/patches/carousel-media.ts
UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

isCarouselHosted

Whether a media-figure is hosted inside a carousel — the figure's shadow root is owned by the slide, so the element's root node is the carousel's own shadow tree and host is the carousel element.

  • @param el The media-figure element being mounted.
  • @returns true when the figure lives inside or

eagerizeCarouselFigure

Eager image path for carousel-hosted figures: flip the thumbnail to loading="eager" (lazy never fires for iOS WebKit inside the scrolled track) and kick the Q50 high-res swap immediately instead of waiting on the IntersectionObserver Safari silently drops. The $ call is optional-chained because the retroactive pass can encounter not-yet-upgraded media-figure elements.

  • @param el The carousel-hosted media-figure.

eagerizeShadowTree

Eager pass over one carousel's shadow tree: flips every painted to loading="eager" (custom-carousel's mirrored pattern backdrops and awards-carousel's lazy slide images alike) and eagerly arms every media-figure inside — covering figures that mounted before the MediaFigure onMounted patch could observe them. safariLoadHighRes early-returns once isLoaded, so repeat passes on re-render are cheap nudges, not duplicate loads.

  • @param host The carousel element whose shadow tree is scanned.

eagerizeShadowImages

Wraps a carousel element's _updateDom so every painted into its own shadow root is forced to eager loading on every re-render. Elements already in the DOM upgrade synchronously inside the customElements.define() call — before this whenDefined() microtask installs the wrap — so a shadow-piercing retroactive pass (deep* queries cross the nested view shadow roots) flips anything painted in that window. Figures mounted later are handled per-mount via eagerizeCarouselFigure() inside the MediaFigure onMounted patch.

  • @param tag Custom-element tag name to wrap.

patchCarouselMedia

Installs the eager-image wrap on both carousel elements — see eagerizeShadowImages for the mechanics.
